## What's new in v2.6.0

### Introducing EnviousMeet (Beta) (#3972)

- **Local meeting recording:** Start and stop recordings from the menu bar or History. EnviousMeet captures your microphone and can also capture call audio on macOS 14.2 or later, saving all recordings and transcripts locally on your Mac.
- **History integration:** Each meeting includes Transcript, Notes, and Summary tabs, playback controls, Transcribe again, Delete audio, and Delete meeting. Running Transcribe again keeps your current transcript visible until the new one is ready.
- **Guided setup:** Walks through a welcome screen, consent box, required permissions (microphone required, call audio required on macOS 14.2 or later, Calendar optional), and six overview cards. EnviousMeet displays a Beta tag in Settings.
- **Call detection:** On macOS 14.2 or later, with Ask selected, a card can offer "Take notes on this <app> call?" for a detected call. Configurable under Settings > EnviousMeet > General > When a call starts (Off, Ask, or Start by itself). When EnviousMeet detects that a linked call ended, a 10-second countdown offers End recording and Keep recording buttons.
- **Supported call apps:** Detects the Zoom app, Teams app, Teams on the web, Google Meet, and Slack huddles. The Call Apps tab includes individual switches for native apps and one shared switch for browser meetings.
- **Live Preview:** With Live Preview set up, displays real-time words during calls using Apple speech (macOS 26) or the Universal engine.
- **Live speaker labels (#4355):** With call audio and the "Speaker labels" download (EnviousMeet > Models), live call text starts under "Speaker". Text the speaker model can assign moves into numbered blocks ("Speaker 1", "Speaker 2") and updates to call app names once confident, while mic text stays under "You".
- **Live label behavior (#4355):** A speaker model downloaded mid-meeting takes effect on the next meeting. Live labels are not fixed identities (similar voices can share a label, and untimed text stays under "Speaker"), and the final transcript is unaffected.
- **Transcript speaker names:** Final transcripts pull speaker names from the Zoom app, Teams app, Google Meet, and Teams and Zoom on the web when evidence is strong, labeling your mic "You" when call audio has speech and falling back to "Speaker 1", "Speaker 2".
- **Mute sync:** "Leave my voice out when I'm muted" (on by default) follows your mute button in the Zoom app, Teams app, and Google Meet in Chrome and Safari, continuing to record your mic if mute status cannot be read. "Record only my voice" is off by default.
- **Echo cleanup:** Reduces call audio bleeding from laptop speakers into your microphone.
- **Transcript engine:** Choose Parakeet or Whisper Large v3 Turbo. Parakeet is shared with dictation (which takes priority), and an optional switch lets you "Turn off dictation during meetings".
- **Summary engine:** Pick Apple Intelligence, EG-1, Ollama, or your own OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude key on the Summaries tab. Cloud summaries send the transcript, notes, and meeting details straight to your chosen provider under your key, never to Envious Labs.
- **Calendar integration:** With "Name meetings from my calendar" on, the matching Calendar event's title, times, and invitees are saved locally with the meeting to title summaries and spell names.
- **Menu bar status:** Shows a rainbow wave while recording a meeting unless an active dictation or warning is displayed.

### Your cloud model choice sticks (#4353)

- Dictation, Transcribe a File, and EnviousMeet each remember their own model selection for every cloud provider (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) across provider switches and app upgrades.
- A newly configured provider starts with no model selected and shows "Choose a model", and dictation pastes without cloud polishing until you pick one.
- If a provider reports that your selected model is no longer available, a notice names the model and offers a button to pick a replacement.
- Available models appear first; within each group, models are ordered newest-first by release date, followed by undated models, while hiding dated duplicates unless selected.
- The model list updates from enviouswispr.com at launch, then at most once every 24 hours while it stays open, via a plain request containing none of your content, falling back to the last good or built-in list if offline.
- Added support for GPT 6.1 Terra, Claude Haiku 5.5, and Gemini 4 Argon.

### History stays fast (#4001)

- History paginates rows, rebuilds once per change, and reuses unchanged rows so search, filters, and reopening stay fast on large libraries.
- Delete All moves the History folder aside and deletes it in the background, finishing automatically on the next launch if the app quits early.
- History edits, Keep, and Delete run in the background and show a short message if an action fails.
- Paste from History restores your previous clipboard when "Restore clipboard after paste" is on, and pastes directly into the app you came from.

### New History tabs (#4260)

- The History tabs are now A, D, T, and M (All, Dictations, Transcripts, Meetings), displaying full names on hover and to VoiceOver.

### Pasting lands in more places

- Pastes into text boxes that an app rebuilds inside the same window instead of showing a "Copied" notice (#3967).
- Command+V presses the physical key mapped to "v" on Dvorak and other keyboard layouts (#4070).
- The Paste Last shortcut now pastes directly into Raycast and Alfred panels (#4073).
- Improved pasting reliability in TinyMCE editors in Chrome (#3982).
- Fewer false "Copied" notices in Apple Mail on macOS 27, cmux, Orca, and Antigravity (#3946, #4025, #4046).
- Removed stray trailing spaces after Chinese, Japanese, Thai, and other languages written without spaces (#3944).

### Smarter word learning

- Learn from edits can now learn a name-like spelling fix when you make it a second time after an initial refusal (#3977).
- Two undos or deletes block a fix; Settings > Dictionary shows how many fixes are blocked, and Forget clears the learning memory (#3977).
- A change from "two" to "2" is never learned (#3971).
- Learned word fixes preserve endings such as "ChatGPT's" and plurals (#4261).
- Quick Add copies the current selection from the menu bar, in Electron apps, and in apps that were not active yet (#4007).
- Dictionary and Snippets now show "Switching from another dictation app?" with a link to import (#4242).

### Dictation formatting

- Added a Configure… button next to Spoken punctuation with the switch English: say "period" for a dot (on by default) so you can turn the command off (#4230).
- Removed the leading space after a spoken "new line" or "new paragraph" (#4150).

### Microphone and setup

- Your first dictation asks for microphone access before recording starts (#4011).
- Setup and the main window offer Open Settings when microphone access is off, and Microphone Settings when no microphone is found (#3962, #3965).
- Silent samples from some USB microphones, such as webcams, are no longer mistaken for a dead microphone, preventing pauses from ending a dictation (#4160).

### Polishing

- Polishing is better at keeping dictated openings such as "Sure," and "Got it." (#4251).
- If EG-1 or S1-mini is stopped from outside the app, the next dictation restarts it automatically, with a notice if a dictation misses polishing (#4028).
- Saving and clearing API keys now run in the background (#4192).
- Apple Intelligence status no longer reports ready after a timed-out check, and its warning clears without a relaunch (#4015, #4241).
- Typing an exact model name in AI Polish > Ollama > Browse models offers to download it, marked "Not tested by us" (#4225).

### Live Preview and Whisper

- Picking Universal requests its download even with Live Preview off, waiting until active meeting recordings and transcriptions finish (#4335).
- Apple's preview can fill in until Universal is ready when the matching language is installed (#4335).
- A language with no region, such as English, previews in your Mac's region when that variant is installed (#4329).
- With Whisper on Auto-detect, Faster Transcription shows as off and asks you to pick a language (#4226).

### Transcribe a File

- Speaker-labeled transcripts keep the space between sentences (#4209).
- Stopping "Clean it again" restores the earlier cleanup when the transcript and speakers are unchanged (#4029).
- Cloud polishing for Gemini and Claude Sonnet sends speaker sections in fewer requests (#3950).

### Fixes

- On macOS 14, Transcribe a File no longer quits while finding speakers (#4389).
- Fixed a crash at quit when the word check had not run (#4009), and quitting now gives an active word check time to finish (#4269).
